WHO WE ARE

Built on Research. Powered by Influential GTM. Delivered by Experts.

CMR has been at the forefront of market research since 1986, backed by CyberMedia, South Asia's largest specialty media group. Today, we combine forward-looking intelligence, strategic advisory and trusted industry influence to help organisations anticipate change and win in evolving markets.

For four decades, CMR has been decoding markets before they take shape — backed by CyberMedia, South Asia's largest specialty media group. Today, we fuse forward-looking intelligence, strategic advisory, and industry influence to help organisations move first and win in markets that never stop shifting.
